messages.subject: where has my model gone!?
parts:
Hi everyone,

My computer has just finished creating a model using the bandit2arm function, and although I specified an object for the model to be stored under, I cant see it in the global environment. I tried running the function a day or two ago and when it had finished, it threw back an error message saying it was unable to allocate a vector of size 62 kb (?!) 
I just don't understand, because ran the function successfully a couple of months ago, and I can still find and call the models generated then, but I cant seem to call the object to access the model that was just created. 

Someone please help!

messages.author: 47d1400f432367d7
messages.subject: Re: where has my model gone!?
parts:
Hi Chad,


Thanks for your interest in hBayesDM! 


I apologize for the trouble you are having—do you mind giving some details on the following:


1) your operating system (Windows, Mac, Linux, etc.) 

2) your R version (you can run sessionInfo() to gather some useful information on the R session)

3) how you downloaded the package (github versus CRAN?)


Additionally, could you upload some example data and the script you are using to run the model so that we can test if the error is reproducible on our own machines? 


I hope we can help solve this issue quickly!


Best,

Nate
